dedupe_keys.name: tfs ns 3 telecom digital twin bridge

description: TFS–NS-3 is a Python framework intended to connect ETSI TeraFlowSDN control with NS-3 network simulation. Its README describes telemetry mirroring, traffic and link-failure perturbations, and a sandbox for comparing corrective actions before applying them to a physical network. Users configure a TeraFlowSDN deployment, NS-3 scenario and telemetry interfaces; outputs are predicted network states and control recommendations. Geographic coverage follows the operator's network. The public LICENSE file contains Apache-2.0 terms, even though GitHub did not classify it with an SPDX value. A limitation is that README claims about closed-loop operation were not tested; hardware adapters and safety checks must be verified for each operator. The framework can support telecom resilience and cascading-service simulations. The related NS-3 catalogue platform supplies the discrete-event network engine, while this repository provides integration code. No simulator or network trace was downloaded.
name: TFS–NS-3 telecom digital-twin bridge
notes: G7 G7-1950. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability. The own README makes operational claims; G7 verified public documentation and licence, not execution or telecom standards conformance.
